name: sp-badminton-tourney-3
description: Professional Full-Stack Tournament Management Application for S.P. Badminton Tourney 3 with MongoDB, Express, Socket.io Realtime Scoring & TV Overlay

scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); ['index.html','admin.html','scorer.html','tv.html','config.js','qr_code.png','logo.png','alert-modal.js'].forEach(f => { const src=path.join('..', f); if(fs.existsSync(src)) fs.copyFileSync(src, path.join('dist', f)); });" && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')){ if(!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); }"

author: S.P. Badminton
